capabilities: Generate unique abbrlink hashes for Markdown files
Write the abbrlink into file frontmatter
Batch-generate abbrlinks for all files from the sidebar
Auto-generate abbrlinks for newly created files
Detect and avoid hash collisions, with configurable hash length
extras: README is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese); generated links are stored as an abbrlink field in frontmatter.
problem: Markdown notes lack stable permanent identifiers, so links tied to file paths break when files are renamed or moved.
summary: Plugin that generates permanent hash-based short links for Markdown files and writes them into frontmatter.
